title: Surreal Artist's Studio
description: An artist's attic studio with a large skylight revealing a vibrant night sky filled with stars, constellations, and shooting stars. In the foreground are two wooden easels: the left holds a finished painting of an empty, minimalist gallery hallway, while the right displays a blank canvas with paint splatters, a palette knife, and a dripping brush.
prompt: An atmospheric artist's loft studio at night, exposed brick walls and wooden beams, large skylight opening to a magical starry night sky with constellations and glowing comets. Two wooden easels stand in the room: one displays a painting of a long empty modern art gallery hallway with soft lighting, the other holds a mostly blank canvas with fresh paint marks and a palette knife resting on it. A vintage radio sits between them on a stool, scattered art supplies and canvases on the floor, cinematic lighting with dramatic beams from above.
